title: Does anyone else find it a bit unsettling that intelligent marine mammals have stopped showing up in many peoples dreams at around the same time that orcas started regularly attacking/ramming boats?

classification.theory_summary: Speculates that intelligent marine mammals stopping appearing in dreams may be connected to real-world orca boat-ramming behavior; suggests dreams could be a warning/alert.
classification.question_topic: Whether others have noticed intelligent marine mammals no longer appearing in dreams around the same time as increased reports of orcas attacking/ramming boats.
classification.skip_reason: No actual dream narrative or described dream scene; only a question/speculation about trends in others' dreams.

meta.author_theory: Intelligent marine mammals may have stopped appearing in dreams as a warning/alert, possibly linked to real-world orca boat-ramming behavior.

extraction.extraction_notes: Phenomenological dream data (locations/sensory qualities/entities within a specific dream) is not present. Only a temporal correlation is mentioned ('stopped showing up... at around the same time').
